# Anycode v0.0.22

This release improves the terminal capabilities, updates themes, stabilizes layout behavior, and optimizes files search.

## Terminal and Layout improvements

- Added support for file upload via drag-and-drop and copy-paste in the terminal.
- Fixed layout scroll resets and jumps during panel activation and dragging.
- Fixed backend terminal character corruption by buffering incomplete UTF-8 bytes at read boundaries.

## File Search and Navigation

- Implemented and optimized workspace files search with keyboard navigation improvements and race-condition fixes.
- Fixed a Rust backend panic when finding local paths containing non-ASCII characters.

## Themes

- Added VS Code Dark+ and Light+ editor themes.
- Added GitHub Default Dark and Light editor themes.
- Added IntelliJ IDEA Darcula and Light editor themes.
- Cleaned up active tab styling.

**Full comparison:** `v0.0.21...v0.0.22`
